Sideview Server Logic

Source: R/app_server.R
sideview_server.Rd

Orchestrates bi-directional Shiny reactivity between the infinite 2D canvas and the R session. Handles field mapping (column_mapped), column renaming (column_renamed), discrepancy calculations (discrepancy_check), natural language AI prompts (run_ai_prompt), RStudio script injection (inject_script), and RStudio console execution (send_console).

Usage

sideview_server(
  cards = list(),
  ...,
  llm_fn = sv_call_llm,
  insert_fn = sv_insert_code,
  console_fn = sv_send_to_console,
  gadget = FALSE,
  run_env = parent.frame()
)

Arguments

cards

A sideview_card object, a list of sideview_card objects, or tabular objects to be normalized.

...

Additional arguments.

llm_fn

Function used to execute LLM queries (default sv_call_llm).

insert_fn

Function used to insert code into active RStudio document (default sv_insert_code).

console_fn

Function used to send code to RStudio console (default sv_send_to_console).

gadget

If TRUE, run as a gadget: the Done and Cancel buttons, closing the RStudio dialog, and closing the last browser tab all stop the app. After the last tab closes the app waits getOption("sideview.session_grace", 5) seconds so a page reload does not end it. Leave FALSE when embedding the server in your own multi-user Shiny app.

run_env

Environment where Run in R evaluates the pipeline and stores its result (as sv_result unless another name is given). Defaults to the environment sideview_server() is called from.

Value

A Shiny server function function(input, output, session).
